text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ

translations.asad: WHEN THE SKY is split asunder,
translations.sahih: When the sky has split [open]

translations.asad: obeying its Sustainer, as in truth it must;
translations.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

translations.asad: and when the earth is leveled,
translations.sahih: And when the earth has been extended

translations.asad: and casts forth whatever is in it, and becomes utterly void,
translations.sahih: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]

translations.asad: obeying its Sustainer, as in truth it must -:
translations.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

text.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ

translations.asad: [then,] O man - thou [that] hast, verily, been toiling towards thy Sustainer in painful toil - then shalt thou meet Him!
translations.sahih: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.

translations.asad: And as for him whose record shall be placed in his right hand,
translations.sahih: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

translations.asad: he will in time be called to account with an easy accounting,
translations.sahih: He will be judged with an easy account

translations.asad: and will [be able to] turn joyfully to those of his own kind.
translations.sahih: And return to his people in happiness.

text.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ

translations.asad: But as for him whose record shall be given to him behind his back;
translations.sahih: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

translations.asad: he will in time pray for utter destruction:
translations.sahih: He will cry out for destruction

translations.asad: but he will enter the blazing flame.
translations.sahih: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

translations.asad: Behold, [in his earthly life] he lived joyfully among people of his own kind
translations.sahih: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

translations.asad: for, behold, he never thought that he would have to return [to God].
translations.sahih: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].

text.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا

translations.asad: Yea indeed! His Sustainer did see all that was in him!
translations.sahih: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.

translations.asad: BUT NAY! I call to witness the sunset's [fleeting] afterglow,
translations.sahih: So I swear by the twilight glow

translations.asad: and the night, and what it [step by step] unfolds,
translations.sahih: And [by] the night and what it envelops

translations.asad: and the moon, as it grows to its fullness:
translations.sahih: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

translations.asad: [even thus, O men,] are you bound to move; onward from stage to stage.
translations.sahih: [That] you will surely experience state after state.

translations.asad: What, then, is amiss with them that they will not believe [in a life to come]?
translations.sahih: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

text.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩

translations.asad: and [that], when the Qur’an is read unto them, they do not fall down in prostration?
translations.sahih: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?

translations.asad: Nay, but they who are bent on denying the truth give the lie [to this divine writ]!
translations.sahih: But those who have disbelieved deny,

translations.asad: Yet God has full knowledge of what they conceal [in their hearts].
translations.sahih: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

translations.asad: Hence, give them the tiding of grievous suffering [in the life to come] –
translations.sahih: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

text.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ

translations.asad: unless it be such [of them] as [repent, and] attain to faith, and do good works: for theirs shall be a reward unending!.
translations.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
